meta.title: 方圆脸出片角度？“2/3脸”太权威了！

scenes.context: 其实方圆脸拍照一点都不难，只要你找到正确的角度，而且不需要搭子很会拍，自己会找角度就行。
sentences: Round faces are not hard to shoot.
The key is finding your own angle.
paraphrase: Round faces are not hard to shoot.
The key is finding your own angle.
scenes.speak: Round faces are not hard to shoot. The key is finding your own angle.

scenes.context: 你听过很多博主说方圆脸要拍侧脸，但你拍的侧脸就是不好看，因为你没找到自己真正好看的角度。
sentences: 要找自己真正好看的角度。
Find the angle that truly flatters you.
paraphrase: Find the angle that truly flatters you.
scenes.speak: Profiles may not suit you. Find the angle that truly flatters you.

scenes.context: 用手机对着镜子录一段视频，这相当于别人给你拍照后置的真实效果。
sentences: Record a video into the mirror.
That's how others actually see you.
how others see you（别人的视角）
paraphrase: Record a video into the mirror.
用how others see you换一种说法
That's how others actually see you.
scenes.speak: Record a video into the mirror. That's how others actually see you.

scenes.context: 录完后发现左脸不适合三分之二侧脸（这块会很大），但左脸抬头就会好看很多。
sentences: My left side doesn't suit the 2/3 profile.
Looking up flatters my left side.
paraphrase: My left side doesn't suit the 2/3 profile.
Looking up flatters my left side.
scenes.speak: My left side doesn't suit the 2/3 profile. Looking up flatters my left side.

scenes.context: 右脸更小一点，比较适合三分之二侧脸，无论抬头低头都好看，侧脸也OK。
sentences: My right side suits the 2/3 profile.
Looks good tilted up or down.
paraphrase: My right side suits the 2/3 profile.
Looks good tilted up or down.
scenes.speak: My right side suits the 2/3 profile. Looks good tilted up or down.

scenes.context: 鼻子高度不够的话纯侧脸会整个脸内凹，多去尝试三分之二侧脸，鼻子不会显得很矮。
sentences: A low nose flattens in a pure profile.
paraphrase: A low nose flattens in a pure profile.
scenes.speak: A low nose flattens in a pure profile. The 2/3 profile flatters the nose.

scenes.context: 让朋友的手机尽量垂直于地面，镜头高度跟下巴一样高，这个角度不容易形成畸变。
sentences: Keep the phone perpendicular to the ground.
paraphrase: Keep the phone perpendicular to the ground.
scenes.speak: Keep the phone perpendicular to the ground. Lens height matches your chin.

scenes.context: 镜头前倾就手抬高蹲低拍俯视角度，镜头上仰就侧脸抬头不看镜头，90%出片。
sentences: Shooting from above slims the face.
If the lens tilts up, tilt your face up too.
paraphrase: Shooting from above slims the face.
If the lens tilts up, tilt your face up too.
scenes.speak: Shooting from above slims the face. If the lens tilts up, tilt your face up too.

practice: Round faces are not hard to shoot.
录一段视频看自己的真实效果。
Record a video to see how you really look.
A low nose flattens in a pure profile.
Keep the phone perpendicular to the ground.
